Class Media3Renderer

java.lang.Object
com.appscend.media.renderers.Media3Renderer
All Implemented Interfaces:
KRAdapter, IVeeplayRenderer
public class Media3Renderer extends Object implements IVeeplayRenderer
Renderer implementation of Media3 ExoPlayer, replacing the ExoPlayer v1 and ExoPlayer2 renderers.
